supersedes.schema: add_pantry_items is redefined (CREATE OR REPLACE, same signature, SECURITY INVOKER and grants): an item sent with category 'aceites y vinagres' is stored and matched as 'básicos'. client: The pantry had a section «Aceites y vinagres». Now its items (aceite de oliva, aceite de girasol, vinagre) are in «Básicos»; a device copy or account row still holding the old section is read as «Básicos».
supersedes.rollout: Order: migration -> code. The deployed client keeps working with the migration applied: it accepts 'básicos' rows, and its adds with the old section are stored in 'básicos' (it shows those items under Básicos).
